title: The Great Balloon Getaway
blurb: The fair's giant balloon has floated off with every prize balloon tied under it. Chase it across the sky!

any: The giant balloon slips its ropes and rises into the night.
Every prize balloon is tied underneath it!
The prize booth is empty. Not one balloon left.
High above, the giant balloon drifts off with all of them.

choices.label: Grab the trailing rope
choices.text: {hero} grabs the rope's end. It tugs toward {place}!

choices.label: Ask a friend
choices.text: {ally} sniffs the air: "{villain}. I'd know that breeze anywhere."

deed.text: got the first clue about the wind

hooks.title: A Note on the Breeze
text: A paper note flutters down from the sky.
It says: CATCH ME IF YOU CAN! Love, {villain}.

choices.label: Chase the shadow!
choices.text: Everyone runs after the big round shadow on the grass.

choices.label: Test the wind
choices.text: {hero} licks a finger and holds it up. "It's going east!"

deed.text: worked out which way the wind blew

beats.title: Over the Rooftops
text: The balloon bumps along the rooftops.
Loose balloons are snagging on every chimney.

callbacks.text: After {who} {deed}, the trail leads up here.

choices.label: Hop the roofs
choices.text: {hero} climbs a drainpipe and scampers along the tiles.

win.text: {winner} unhooks a whole bunch of balloons from a chimney.

lose.text: {loser} sits on a chimney and pops out a bit sooty.

choices.label: Use a long pole
choices.text: {hero} finds a window pole with a hook on the end.

win.text: {winner} hooks string after string. What a haul!

lose.text: {loser} hooks a pair of socks off a washing line.

deed.text: fished socks off a washing line

beats.title: Splashdown at the Pond
text: A cloud of balloons bobs low over the lily pond.
A very proud swan is guarding them.

choices.label: Row out fast
choices.text: Everyone piles into a little rowing boat.

win.text: {winner} rows the fastest and scoops up the balloons.

lose.text: {loser} rows in a perfect circle. The swan claps.

deed.text: rowed in circles for a swan

choices.label: Fish for strings
choices.text: {hero} ties a hook to a stick. The strings dangle in the water.

win.text: {winner} reels in a whole bouquet of balloons.

deed.text: fished balloons out of the pond

lose.text: {loser} catches a lily pad and wears it as a hat.

deed.text: wore a lily pad as a hat

beats.title: Kite Hill
text: Kite Hill is windy and full of kites.
Balloons are tangled up with the kite tails!

callbacks.text: {who} {deed}, so you knew to come here.

choices.label: Fly a kite up
choices.text: {hero} grabs a kite and runs into the wind.

game.intro: Steer your kite to the balloons!

win.text: {winner} flies right through the tangle and frees them.

lose.text: {loser} gets lifted onto tiptoe by a big kite. Wheee!

deed.text: was nearly flown by a kite

choices.label: Build one huge kite
choices.text: Everyone ties their kites into one giant kite.

win.text: The giant kite soars up and drags every balloon back down.

lose.text: The kite wobbles, but it still brings a few balloons down.

beats.title: The Whirling Windmill
text: The balloon's anchor is caught on the windmill sails.
Round and round it goes, faster and faster!

callbacks.text: {who} {deed}. The windmill turns just as you said.

choices.label: Ride the sails
choices.text: {hero} times a jump onto the passing sail.

game.intro: Hop on in time with the sails!

win.text: {winner} rides up top and unhooks the anchor.

lose.text: {loser} goes round three times and lands in the flour.

deed.text: landed in a sack of flour

choices.label: Find the brake
choices.text: {hero} slips inside. Gears and levers everywhere!

game.intro: Pull the levers in the right order!

win.text: {winner} pulls the right lever. The sails creak to a stop.

lose.text: {loser} pulls the wrong lever and grinds some porridge oats.

beats.title: The Gust Machine
text: {villain} leans over the basket with giant bellows.
WHOOSH! A gust sends everyone's hats flying.

choices.label: Push into the wind
choices.text: {hero} leans forward and marches, step by step.

win.text: {winner} reaches the rope and gives the bellows a big tug. Squeak!

lose.text: {loser} is blown backwards into a haystack.

choices.label: Fill it with bubbles
choices.text: {hero} pours bubble mix into the bellows' nose.

game.intro: Sneak the bubble mix past them!

win.text: {winner} does it! The next gust is all bubbles. Pop pop pop!

lose.text: {loser} gets spotted and blown a big bubble right on the nose.

deed.text: wore a bubble on the nose

beats.title: A Floating Sheep
text: A fluffy sheep drifts past, tied to three balloons.
"Baa?" it says, quite calmly.

choices.label: Bring it down gently
choices.text: Everyone reaches up for the dangling strings.

game.intro: Catch the strings before it floats off!

win.text: {winner} pulls the sheep down for a cuddle. It follows you now.

lose.text: {loser} gets a woolly bump on the head. Soft, at least.

deed.text: was bumped by a flying sheep

choices.label: Count the balloons
choices.text: {hero} works out how many to pop to land it softly.

win.text: {winner} pops just one. The sheep drifts down like a feather.

deed.text: landed a sheep as soft as a feather

lose.text: {loser} pops the wrong one and the sheep spins like a top.

deed.text: made a sheep spin like a top

beats.title: The Spinning Weathervanes
text: Every weathervane in town is pointing a different way.
{villain} has spun them all to fool you!

choices.label: Read the clouds
choices.text: {hero} squints at the clouds. They know the truth.

game.intro: Which way is the wind really blowing?

win.text: {winner} reads the clouds and points. "That way!"

deed.text: read the clouds like a map

lose.text: {loser} sees a cloud shaped like a duck and gets distracted.

choices.label: Race every way
choices.text: Everyone picks a weathervane and runs where it points.

win.text: {winner} picks the right one and finds dropped balloons.

lose.text: {loser} runs the wrong way and finds a nice bakery.

beats.title: Into the Clouds
text: The balloon climbs into the clouds.
The clouds here are soft and bouncy, like pillows.

extra.text: The fluffy sheep bounces ahead to show the way. Baa!

choices.label: Bounce cloud to cloud
choices.text: Everyone takes a run-up and jumps. Boing!

win.text: {winner} bounces highest and grabs the anchor rope.

lose.text: {loser} sinks into a cloud and comes out damp.

choices.label: Build a cloud stair
choices.text: {hero} pats the clouds into neat little steps.

win.text: {winner} builds a staircase right up to the basket.

deed.text: built a staircase out of clouds

lose.text: {loser} builds a cloud sofa instead and has a little sit.

beats.title: Toss in the Sandbags
text: The basket hangs just out of reach.
If it gets heavier, it will sink down to you!

choices.label: Shoot the sandbags
choices.text: {hero} picks up a sandbag and lines up the throw.

game.intro: Get the sandbags in the basket!

win.text: Swish! {winner} sinks the last bag. The basket drops lower.

deed.text: sank a sandbag into the basket

lose.text: {loser} throws a sandbag straight up. It lands with a flump.

choices.label: Jump for it
choices.text: {hero} crouches low, ready to spring.

game.intro: Jump at just the right moment!

win.text: {winner} catches the basket's edge and pulls it down.

deed.text: leapt up and caught the basket

lose.text: {loser} jumps a moment late and does a lovely twirl.

beats.title: The Tickle Storm
text: A small grey cloud rolls in, rumbling.
It is not raining. It is tickling!

callbacks.text: {who} {deed}, so the cloud is a bit shy of you.

choices.label: Hold on together
choices.text: Everyone links arms and tries very hard not to giggle.

win.text: Nobody giggles! The little cloud gives up and drifts off.

deed.text: kept a straight face in a tickle storm

lose.text: Everyone giggles so hard the cloud giggles too.

deed.text: got the giggles in a tickle storm

choices.label: Sing it to sleep
choices.text: {hero} starts humming a lullaby.

win.text: {winner} hums so sweetly the storm cloud starts to snore.

deed.text: sang a storm cloud to sleep

lose.text: {loser} sings a wobbly note and the cloud sneezes on them.

deed.text: got sneezed on by a cloud

interludes.title: A Lucky Feather
text: A shiny gold feather spins down from the sky.
It glitters and floats like it weighs nothing.

choices.label: Tuck it in your hat
choices.text: {hero} tucks the feather in a hat. Feels lucky!

choices.label: Let it fly on
choices.text: {hero} blows it gently. It floats off to bring luck to all.

deed.text: sent a lucky feather on its way

interludes.title: {ally} Waves
text: {ally} runs up with a jug of cold lemonade.
"Chasing balloons is thirsty work!"

choices.label: Take a quick sip
choices.text: Fizzy, sweet and cold. Everyone feels light as air.

choices.label: Drink it on the run
choices.text: {hero} gulps lemonade at a sprint. Hic!

climax.title: The Great Gust
text: {villain} stands in the basket, hugging {prize}.
"These balloons are MINE! Feel my mightiest gust!"

extra.text: The bellows only wheeze now. Ha!

choices.label: Pull it down together
choices.text: Everyone grabs the anchor rope. One, two, three, PULL!

game.intro: Beat the gusts and haul it down!

win.text: The balloon lands with a soft bump. {villain} hands back {prize}.

lose.text: A big gust snatches the rope away. Up it goes again!

choices.label: Pop the knot first
choices.text: {hero} spots the one knot holding {prize}.

game.intro: Untie the knot before the gust!

win.text: {winner} flicks the knot loose. {prize} floats right down!

deed.text: freed the prize with one flick

lose.text: {loser} ties their own shoelaces together by mistake.

climax.title: Race Across the Sky
text: {villain} cuts {prize} loose to escape faster!
It drifts toward the moon. Somebody grab it!

callbacks.text: {who} {deed}. The sky feels like home now.

extra.text: The giant kite swoops in to help!

choices.label: Out-fly them
choices.text: {hero} grabs a bunch of balloons and floats up after it.

win.text: {winner} catches {prize} and floats down, waving.

deed.text: caught the prize in the sky

lose.text: {loser} floats sideways and lands in a tree. Comfy.

choices.label: Blow it home together
choices.text: Everyone takes the biggest breath ever.

win.text: WHOOSH! {prize} sails home and {villain} lands, red-faced.

lose.text: Everyone runs out of puff. {villain} floats away, laughing.

deed.text: puffed and puffed at the sky

any: The balloons are home and tied to the prize booth.
{villain} now blows up balloons for the children.
The giant balloon lands back on the fairground.
Every child gets a free balloon in the morning!
Most balloons are home, but {prize} is still up there.
Watch the sky next fair night…
But the fair still has plenty of balloons, thanks to you!

lines.text: The golden feather now sits in the prize booth's window.
The fluffy sheep wears a balloon on its tail now.
A sleepy little cloud follows the fair around.
